description: Extract a one-time / verification code (a 4–8 digit number) from recent mail in a scoped inbox. GOVERNED: codes are only ever read from senders ALLOWLISTED in the mailbox policy — mail from any other sender is ignored, never scanned. Returns {status:"found", code, from, message_id} or {status:"not_found"}. Read-only; requires the `read` capability.

from.description: Optional sender filter (the expected code sender).

inbox_id.description: Inbox (mailbox) id. Must be in scope for the token.

max_age_minutes.description: Ignore messages older than this many minutes.

name: mailbuttons_extract_code
title: Extract a verification code
